channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David West | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David West from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on David West
item.description:
Adam Lauridsen:Pop on West:

“He's a class act. He's a contemplative guy. He thinks about things beyond basketball.”

Gregg Popovich on David West, May 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @GSWFastBreak.

item.title: Kevin Durant on David West
item.description:
Answer won't exactly stop speculation of him to Spurs:Asked about David West Kevin Durant:

“They're deep. In this game, it's not about having the best names on the court at all times. They got smart basketball players to the 14th, 15th man. They all know how to play. They all can do multiple things out there on the court. David West was an All-Star. Patty Mills is a great backup point guard. (Manu) Ginobili was an All-Star at one point. They got guys who know how to play the game, veteran guys. That's what good teams have is depth. That's why both teams are here at this point.”

Kevin Durant on David West, May 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Kenny Smith on Tim Duncan, David West
item.description:
Smith said this past week on a conference call.

“I think he’s a really underrated rebounder and his ability to shoot from the outside will give Tim Duncan some good looks inside. You add David West to that mix, I don’t see how they don’t win the West.”

Kenny Smith on Tim Duncan, David West, Nov 1, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Paul George on Roy Hibbert, Luis Scola, David West
item.description:
“Losing D-West, Roy (Hibbert via trade to the Los Angeles Lakers) and (veteran forward Luis) Scola (via free agency to the Toronto Raptors) were something that I didn’t see coming,”

Paul George on Roy Hibbert, Luis Scola, David West, Sep 27, 2015. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Zach Randolph, David West, Andre Drummond
item.description:
Stan Van Gundy:

“Um...you know I'll be honest -- I go back and forth on it. I really do. Because I think Greg is an outstanding player and I think he's a high-character guy as well. And I think those are the guys that you generally want to build around. But I don't think that, you know, he and Andre Drummond are the best fit. Not saying you couldn't make it work, but certainly not the best fit. First of all, I think the game is moving smaller and quicker as it is. The teams that have continued to play with two big guys - at least one if not both are guys who can step away and make shots. Indiana played with David West. Memphis plays with Zach Randolph. Those guys can all go 17, 18 feet and make shots.”

Stan Van Gundy on Zach Randolph, David West, Andre Drummond, Aug 5, 2015. Source: Detroit Bad Boys.

item.title: Larry Bird on David West
item.description:
Scott Agness:Larry Bird on David West:

“Everything we did this summer was because of his decision (to opt out).”

Larry Bird on David West, Jul 14, 2015. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Larry Bird on David West
item.description:
Scott Agness:Bird on David West:

“He's done more for this franchise than he can even imagine.… He was our No. 1 get this summer and we got him!”

Larry Bird on David West, Jul 10, 2013. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on David West
item.description:
Added Pritchard:

“(West) knows we’re in a great position moving forward. He’s priority No. 1and come July 1 (the start of free agency) we’ll have a lot of conversations.”

Kevin Pritchard on David West, Jun 13, 2013. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Dell Demps on Emeka Okafor, David West
item.description:
“I feel the same sentiment to the fans, to David West, Emeka Okafor, to everybody. We want to put together a team that can compete with the best.”

Dell Demps on Emeka Okafor, David West, Apr 8, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.
